text:
violet: Sales just pressed hard: 'Customer X will pause onboarding unless tenant routing + enterprise SSO lands in v1.' They gave a June 18 date.
drew: Ouch. Define "enterprise SSO" for them?
violet: Their ask: OIDC login, SCIM provisioning (one-way), and audit streaming to their Splunk instance.
mara: Our roadmap currently has SSO as v1 but with SCIM in the post-GA backlog. June 18 is ~4 weeks earlier than our GA target.
oscar: If we pull SCIM forward, the biggest cost is QA (matrix with HR systems) and some infra (SCIM endpoints + throttling).
drew: Can we do an OIDC-first canary for June 18 and promise SCIM by the public v1 GA date?
violet: Sales says they'd accept an OIDC-first canary if we give a firm SCIM GA date and weekly checkpoints. They specifically want audit logs working for security review.
lee: Engineering quick sketch: OIDC + audit stream (~3w if prioritized), SCIM ~4w of dev + 1w intensive testing. Serially that's too long; parallelizing gets to ~5w.
mara: Cuts we can push to v1.1: promo experiment UI, long-term analytics retention, and the new cohort-surfaces. Those aren't blocking onboarding.
oscar: Operational note: run canary on a feature-flag and limit to 2 pilot orgs. Route through a small dedicated pool in us-west until we validate.
drew: Legal impact: enterprise SLA + data handling add 1-2w of review. Loop legal early.
legal-bot: Opened LEGAL-2107 "enterprise-sso-sla-review" and assigned to @lee_counsel.
violet: Proposal: offer OIDC + audit streaming canary on Jun 18 (feature-flag, 2 pilots). Commit to SCIM GA by Jul 20 in product schedule. Slide promo UI and extended retention to v1.1. Weekly checkpoints with customer.
mara: I can write a short decision doc with acceptance criteria: successful logins for 2 pilots, audit events validated in Splunk, <1% auth errors, documented rollback.
oscar: I'll draft infra canary plan and traffic gating by Friday. Engineering needs two engineers reallocated for 4-6 weeks.
drew: I'll coordinate with sales to set expectation language and confirm the customer's acceptance.
lee: I'll kick off legal review and try to get SLA draft in 5 business days.
violet: Decision recorded here. If customer signs off on the canary scope, we'll proceed with the plan and update the roadmap.
